messages:
ryan: Seeing weird quota churn for org-110 over the last 20m, tokens billed up ~15% but success rate same. anyone else?
sam: I'm seeing a pattern where exchange requests that lack project header get routed to 'projectless' bucket and billed to fallback project, which is inflating counts. did we change routing order in auth-proxy?
leila: yes, yesterday's patch flipped affinity order to prefer origin-binding before token-affinity. should reduce cross-tenant routing but might hit requests with missing `x-origin-project` header
maya: many internal console routes (healthchecks, cron jobs) omit `x-origin-project`. they should have been using token-affinity. this flip could cause mass attribution to a single fallback billing project
ops: infra-bot: metric alert auth.quota.unexpected_increase triggered for org-110 (15% increase)
deploy-bot: change-deploy: rolled auth-proxy v3 to prod @ 2026-03-22T14:05Z
ryan: ok that aligns. urgent ask: can we temporarily patch routing to do affinity fallback when header absent? small config toggle so we don't redeploy code
sam: we have a flag `auth.prefers_origin_binding=true`. pushing `false` on canary then prod should flip behavior. but need to be careful with global rollout, will affect our cross-org isolation guarantees
leila: agree. propose a scoped toggle: apply to tenant org-110 only via routing rules until we validate. we have tenant-scoped feature flags in Console.
maya: +1. Also need to emit `auth.attribution.path` and `auth.routing.reason` tags to telemetry so we can verify attribution post-change. current metrics only show final project id and token hash, not why routing happened
ryan: also we need a short-term dashboard: per-project token count and attribution_delta (current - baseline). put it on the Billing Ops dashboard so finance can see impact in near-real time
ops: note: quota caches may still have stale mapping. after toggling flag we'll want to flush `auth-attrib-cache` for org-110. otherwise counts won't correct immediately
sam: doing two steps: 1) apply tenant flag for org-110 2) kick cache flush job for that org 3) emit debug samples for 10% of affected requests with hashed token + route_reason
leila: please ensure debug samples avoid logging raw tokens/org ids. use HMAC256(token, key_id) and only store hex digest and tenant hash
ryan: add rollout rule: if attribution delta >5% after toggle for 15m, revert and open incident. Keep human-in-the-loop for prod-wide changes
maya: I'll open a console ticket to set the tenant flag and link to this thread. Also will add a small unit test to the auth-proxy suite for header-absent behavior to prevent regression
ops: infra-bot: tenant flag updated: auth.prefers_origin_binding=false for tenant org-110 (applied)
ops: infra-bot: cache-flush job queued: auth-attrib-cache flush for org-110 (job id cf-9921)
sam: sampling bumped for `auth.attribution` to 100% for org-110 for 30m to collect enough debug samples
leila: created PR #4247 with change note and test. will merge after one review. also adding metric `auth.routing.reason` values: origin_header_missing, token_affinity, origin_binding, fallback_projectyan: great. follow-ups: dashboard tile for Billing Ops (maya), sampling revert in 30m (sam), PR merge and release (leila), postmortem note and finance sync (maya).
maya: filing incident note in incidents channel and pinging finance. adding trace links here: trace ids start with zyx- where we saw highest delta
leila: thanks team. once metrics show delta back to baseline we'll schedule a full rollout with the improved telemetry and automated canary checks to avoid repeating this surprise attribution spike
